amendments.architecture_note: CAPABILITY OWNERSHIP IS NOT ROOT AUTHORITY. These entries record who owns a JOB, not who may authorize effects. tools/vanguard/governor.mjs is deliberately NOT filed under `authorization-governor`: an independent audit established its only export is pulse(n) (governor.mjs:42), which spawns subprocesses and appends a receipt — it orchestrates the metabolism, it does not authorize anything. Root authorization is UNSETTLED and is being decided separately; registry repair must not decide architecture.

The census reads inert data and mints no authorization — the authority plane (tools/authority + the Hermes grant path) is disjoint from the census (proven by capability-admission.test.mjs COURT 3/6). Registering this job does not make the registry an authorizer, and a registry entry is neither necessary nor sufficient for a grant.
